task: Implement Phase 7 typed in-silico validation and durable, current-hash-bound scientist then lab-lead approval gates, ending at APPROVED_FOR_WET_LAB without enabling or invoking real wet-lab execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Typed in-silico requests and results provide deterministic proceed, revise, and reject outcomes, with malformed or unavailable real validation failing closed.
Canonical SHA-256 proposal and validation-result hashes bind every durable validation and approval record so edited proposals retain history but invalidate stale authorization.
APPROVED_FOR_WET_LAB is unreachable without credential-verified scientist approval followed by credential-verified lab-lead approval for the current proposal and validation result.
Canvas Notes, titles, connectors, author fields, model output, and free text are non-authorizing topology or projection data and cannot create human approval evidence.
Approval credentials are re-verified on replay, never persisted, and idempotent retries return the original durable approval when all stable evidence matches.
Validation, approvals, rejection, restart recovery, and Browser artifact projections are append-only or idempotent and remain correct across process restarts.
wet_lab_execution_enabled defaults to false, approval artifacts retain execution_enabled false, and no Phase 7 code path calls a real robot, hardware SDK, laboratory API, or wet-lab adapter.
Full tests, lint, type checks, compilation, workflow parity, documentation reconciliation, and adversarial review pass with no critical finding and the Phase 7 safety contract intact.
blastRadius: approval identity, role ordering, credential handling, and replay semantics
SQLite migrations and append-only validation and approval evidence
proposal and result hashing, stale-evidence invalidation, and restart projection
watcher dispatch boundaries and default-disabled execution
Browser artifact rendering and non-authorizing Canvas topology
legacy mock loop compatibility and dependent terminal-stop integration
documentation of Phase 7 safety and Phase 8 execution boundaries
contracts: The deterministic adapter is structural screening labelled not scientific validation; the real adapter remains disabled and fails closed.
Only the credential-bearing IdentityProvider boundary can establish an approver identity and role; credentials are SecretStr inputs and are never persisted.
Scientist approval must precede lab-lead approval, and both must bind the current canonical proposal and validation-result hashes.
Historical validation and approval rows are retained, but stale hashes never authorize the current proposal.
Canvas topology and generated projections remain non-authorizing even when titles, connectors, notes, or author text appear approval-like.
Phase 7 terminates at APPROVED_FOR_WET_LAB with execution_enabled false; wet-lab dispatch remains disabled by default and no real execution integration exists.
The enabled compatibility boundary, when explicitly configured in later work, can create only clearly labelled model-generated MOCK_RESULT artifacts.
No failing test, lint, type, compilation, parity, or inspection result may be represented as a passing delivery gate.
